role: statically evidenced profile persistence transaction candidate
semantic_claim: The function is modeled only as an ordered candidate boundary. No manager membership, outer save envelope, commit, rollback, or atomicity claim is made.

implementation.model: separate profile candidate ports with no editor transient or UI state

stack_arguments.name: candidate_marker
stack_arguments.observed_access_at_gates: ESP+0x120 after the 0x110-byte entry ESP adjustment
stack_arguments.observed_use: nonzero value gates both the candidate-target and completion sequences

input_gate.fact: A null path or an empty UTF-16 string returns before every service call. For a nonempty path, the byte at entry ESP+8, the second stack argument, gates both the candidate-target and completion sequences.

observed_execution_order.fact: Initialize the candidate and acquire the observed species context.

When the second stack argument is nonzero, call the primary-target availability service. If the availability result is zero, skip target, species-application, mode, and path-binding calls; otherwise load the primary target and only when that output is null load the secondary target.
When the species context is non-null, apply it, then read the current mode.
Set the mode service and mode field only for 0x1654c00, 0x1654c01, 0x1654c02, 0x1654c04, or 0x1654c05. No mode write occurs for another value.
Modes 0x1654c02 and 0x1654c04 replace, bind, configure, and invoke the mode-target cleanup boundary with the replace result, including a null result.
Set the supplied path, then release a non-null loaded target.
Build the observed context, prepare the temporary-profile service, and create path forms for the supplied path and '.tmp'.
Run the primary temporary-profile body and its release sequence. The branch at 0x00b29317 is not a valid safe null path because the object is unconditionally dereferenced at 0x00b293ac.
When the second stack argument at entry ESP+8 is nonzero, read context byte +0x44 and select one of two completion services; a zero marker skips both the completion read and run.
Set the final application mode to 6, release the primary service object, release temporary strings, and destroy the stack context.

direct_caller_evidence.fact: The direct caller saves its incoming ECX receiver, pushes a profile path and candidate marker, then calls 0x00b28ec0 and later performs a separate service result check. The later check is not folded into this model.

unresolved_contradictions: Ghidra's current decompiler prototype exposes one stack parameter, while the prologue and RET 0x8 prove two four-byte stack arguments. The incoming ECX is saved by the target and supplied as a receiver by the direct caller, so the second stack word is modeled as the candidate marker at entry ESP+8.
The primary temporary-profile object null check at 0x00b29317 is followed by unconditional dereferences, so a safe null-error return is not evidenced and is not modeled.
The exact ownership or manager membership of the species, profile, and mode targets is not established. All three remain opaque and are not stored by the model.
The two completion services are selected by a context byte only when the candidate marker is nonzero; atomic replacement, commit, and rollback semantics are not established.
The caller performs post-call service checks outside 0x00b28ec0; those checks are not included in this inner candidate boundary.
